_: Hand-authored design content: the ONE shape feature that tells each unit
apart at 48x48 in a crowd of forty. At Rumblejam's density silhouette is
the entire readability budget — colour and interior detail are secondary,
because at 36 css px on a dark floor with 200 enemies alive, outline is
Rules for editing: every note is a SHAPE, never a colour or a material.
Every note must be distinguishable from all 63 others as a black cutout.
Keep them short — they are one clause of a prompt, not a character brief.
tools/gen_prompts.mjs turns these into docs/prompts.json. Subjects come
from the content tables; only the silhouette is authored here.
